description:
Title: Work Accident

Create a process that helps in gathering information about work accidents (and almost work accidents):
For insured gainful employment, a work accident is considered to be an accident that occurs in the following circumstances, by way of example:
* the accident occurs in a location, at a time and with a cause that correlates to the insured employment
* when working from home
* on the direct route from the permanent place of residence to work, to lunch or on the way home, whereby carpools are also protected
* for training sessions that serve to provide specific professional knowledge, whereby an accident on to way to or from the training centre is considered a work accident
* on the direct route from home, or from the workplace or training centre to a doctor and back, if this interrupts the direct route from the permanent place of residence to work or the route home (the doctor's visit must be notified to the employer in advance)
* on the way to or from the workplace or training centre with the purpose of taking a child to or collecting them from a childcare facility, a daycare facility, external care or a school, insofar as they have a supervisory responsibility for the child
* when making use of advocacy groups or professional associations (e.g. Chamber of Labour, trade union federation, guild etc.)

For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, an accident is considered to be a work accident if, amongst other things
* the accident occurs in a location, at a time and with a cause that correlates to the school or university education or the compulsory kindergarten year that forms the basis of the insurance
* when taking part in a school event or school-related event 
* on the direct route from the child's place of residence or permanent accommodation to kindergarten or a school visit or on the way home
* when performing a practical task prescribed as part of the curriculum and/or the study regulations or 
* in certain professional (training) orientations.

In an agricultural or forestry establishment, accidents can be considered work accidents if they do not occur directly while performing the insured employment.
Depending on the protected group of people, the following tasks are covered by accident insurance:
* working in the household of the owner of the company and/or the employee, if the household serves the company to a considerable extent
* working in connection with providing accommodation for guests 
* secondary occupations for the sale of agricultural products from the farm
* working in the context of erecting, converting and repairing buildings that serve the agricultural and forestry establishment
* working in the context of neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural and forestry establishment  

Certain accidents are considered the same as work accidents and in many cases can also affect people who do not have accident insurance.
Accidents that occur in one of the following situations, among others, are considered to be work accidents outside of professional activity:
* for activities with which services from the Unemployment Insurance Act / Labor Market Promotion Act are being made use of (e.g. on the way to an arranged job interview)
* when assisting with an accident or donating blood
* when receiving training, taking part in exercises or serving as a member of one of the following aid organisations:
    * Volunteer fire brigade
    * Volunteer water rescue service
    * Volunteer rescue organisations
    * Austrian Red Cross
    * Austrian Alpine Rescue Service
    * Austrian Water Rescue
    * Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade
    * Avalanche warning committees
    * Air rescue service
    * Radiation detection and survey crews

The employees must inform the employer immediately of:
* any work accident
* any incident that would almost have led to an accident
* any serious and immediate risk to safety and health that they discover
* any defect discovered in protection systems.

The employer must, in turn, immediately report any work accident that leads to a fatality or serious injury to the Labour Inspectorate, if it has not been reported to the emergency services.

Independent of this, every work accident in which a person with accident insurance has been killed, or injured in such a way that they are unable to work for three days, in full or in part, must be reported to the responsible accident insurance provider within five days.

As a self-employed person, please ensure that you not only report accidents involving people you employ but also those that involve you to the accident insurance provider in good time.

Students and schoolchildren should report accidents to the competent directorate.
Schools, educational facilities and universities are obliged to report every work accident through which a person with accident insurance is physically injured or killed within a maximum of five days to the responsible accident insurance provider in triplicate.

In the case of private insurance, the insured party must report an accident in writing immediately in line with the conditions and to avoid the provider from being released from the obligation to perform.
If there are fatalities, this must be reported within three days, even if the accident has already been reported.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployeeNotification" name="Immediate employee notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LabourInspectorateReport" name="Fatal or serious work accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AccidentInsuranceReport" name="Accident insurance report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SelfEmployedInsuranceReport" name="Self-employed accident insurance report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DirectorateReport" name="Student or schoolchild accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_SchoolInsuranceReport" name="School or educational institution accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateInsuranceReport" name="Private insurance accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Private insurance fatality report"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_WorkAccidentProcess" name="Work accident reporting" processRef="Process_WorkAccident"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employer" name="Employer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurer" name="Responsible accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployeeToEmployer" name="Immediate notification" sourceRef="Task_NotifyEmployer" targetRef="Participant_Employer" messageRef="Message_EmployeeNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ToInspectorate" name="Report fatal or serious work accident" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate" messageRef="Message_LabourInspectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ToAccidentInsurer" name="Report qualifying work accident within five days" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_AccidentInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SelfEmployedToInsurer" name="Report in good time" sourceRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_SelfEmployedInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StudentToDirectorate" name="Report accident" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Participant_Directorate" messageRef="Message_DirectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SchoolToInsurer" name="Report in triplicate within five days" sourceRef="Task_SchoolReport" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurer" messageRef="Message_SchoolInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateToInsurer" name="Immediate written report" sourceRef="Task_PrivateReport" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateFatalityToInsurer" name="Fatality report within three days" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer" messageRef="Message_PrivateFatalityReport"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Incident" name="Accident or safety event occurs or is discovered"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherInformation" name="Gather incident information"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessCoverage" name="Assess applicable work-accident coverage">
      <bpmn:documentation>Record the circumstances and assess them against the applicable coverage criteria. For insured gainful employment, examples include an accident at a location, time and with a cause related to the insured employment; working from home; the direct route between permanent residence and work, lunch or home (including carpools); specific professional training and the direct route to or from its centre; a doctor visit and return from home, workplace or training centre where it interrupts the direct route to work or home, if the visit was notified to the employer in advance; travel to or from work or training to take a child to or collect a child from childcare, daycare, external care or school where the person has supervisory responsibility; and use of advocacy groups or professional associations, such as the Chamber of Labour, trade union federation or guild.
For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, examples include circumstances, location and time related to the insured school or university education or compulsory kindergarten year; participation in a school or school-related event; the direct route between the child's residence or permanent accommodation and kindergarten or school and the way home; practical tasks prescribed by the curriculum or study regulations; and certain professional training orientations.
In agricultural or forestry establishments, covered tasks can include work in the household of the owner or employee where it serves the establishment to a considerable extent; work providing guest accommodation; secondary occupations selling farm products; erecting, converting or repairing buildings serving the establishment; and neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural or forestry establishment. Depending on the protected group, such accidents may be considered work accidents even when not occurring directly during the insured employment.
Accidents outside professional activity may also be treated as work accidents, including activities using services under the Unemployment Insurance Act or Labor Market Promotion Act (for example, travel to an arranged job interview); assisting at an accident or donating blood; and training, exercises or service as a member of the listed aid organisations: Volunteer fire brigade, Volunteer water rescue service, Volunteer rescue organisations, Austrian Red Cross, Austrian Alpine Rescue Service, Austrian Water Rescue, Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade, avalanche warning committees, air rescue service, or radiation detection and survey crews.
Also record whether the incident was a work accident, an almost-accident, a serious and immediate safety or health risk, or a defect in a protection system. These latter three incident types must be reported by employees to the employer immediately.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" name="Select applicable reporting duties" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately" messageRef="Message_EmployeeNotification"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerInjuryThreshold" name="Did the work accident cause a fatality or serious injury?" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmergencyServicesReported" name="Has it been reported to emergency services?" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportInspectorate" name="Report fatal or serious work accident to Labour Inspectorate immediately" messageRef="Message_LabourInspectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployerReportMerge" name="Continue employer reporting route" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer" name="Report qualifying work accident to accident insurer within five days" messageRef="Message_AccidentInsuranceReport">
      <bpmn:documentation>Applies when a person with accident insurance has been killed or injured so that they are unable to work for three days, in full or in part. This reporting duty applies independently of the Labour Inspectorate report.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SelfEmployedReport" name="Self-employed person reports accident to accident insurer in good time" messageRef="Message_SelfEmployedInsuranceReport">
      <bpmn:documentation>Report accidents involving people employed by the self-employed person and accidents involving the self-employed person.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportDirectorate" name="Student or schoolchild reports accident to competent directorate" messageRef="Message_DirectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SchoolReport" name="School or educational institution reports accident to insurer in triplicate within five days" messageRef="Message_SchoolInsuranceReport">
      <bpmn:documentation>Applies to every work accident through which a person with accident insurance is physically injured or killed.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateReport" name="Privately insured person reports accident in writing immediately" messageRef="Message_PrivateInsuranceReport">
      <bpmn:documentation>Report in line with the private insurance conditions, to avoid release of the provider from its obligation to perform.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateFatality" name="Was there a fatality?" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" name="Report fatality to private insurer within three days, even if already reported" messageRef="Message_PrivateFatalityReport"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateReportMerge" name="Continue private insurance route" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin" name="Join applicable reporting duties" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ReportingComplete" name="Applicable reporting duties completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Gather" sourceRef="StartEvent_Incident" targetRef="Task_GatherInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_Assess" sourceRef="Task_GatherInformation" targetRef="Task_AssessCoverage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_Routes" sourceRef="Task_AssessCoverage" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Employee" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_NotifyEmployer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">employee_event = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Insurer" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">insured_person_killed = true or insured_person_unable_to_work_for_at_least_three_days = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_SelfEmployed" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">self_employed_person_or_their_employee_involved = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Student" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_ReportDirectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">student_or_schoolchild_accident = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_School" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_SchoolReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">school_educational_facility_or_university_reporting_duty_applies = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Routes_Private" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutes" targetRef="Task_PrivateReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">private_insurance_applies = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notify_Threshold" sourceRef="Task_NotifyEmployer" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerInjuryThreshold"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Threshold_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerInjuryThreshold" targetRef="Gateway_EmergencyServicesReported">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatality = true or serious_injury = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Threshold_No" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerInjuryThreshold" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerReportMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatality = false and serious_injury = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Emergency_Reported" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencyServicesReported" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerReportMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">reported_to_emergency_services = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Emergency_NotReported" sourceRef="Gateway_EmergencyServicesReported" targetRef="Task_ReportInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">reported_to_emergency_services = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspectorate_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ReportInspectorate" targetRef="Gateway_EmployerReportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerMerge_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployerReportMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurer_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurer" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_Join" sourceRef="Task_SelfEmployedReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_School_Join" sourceRef="Task_SchoolReport" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateReport_Fatality" sourceRef="Task_PrivateReport" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatality_Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatality = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatality_No" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatality" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateReportMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatality = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatalityReport_Merge" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatalityReport" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateReportMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateMerge_Join" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateReportMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_ReportingRoutesJoin" targetRef="EndEvent_ReportingComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
